if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
the supply is a supply of goods
then: for goods, the tax invoice MUST carry the quantity and the unit or Unique Quantity Code
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(i), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: quantity in case of goods and unit or Unique Quantity Code thereof;
